milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the potted dandelion (at spawn-relative 5, 0, 3 — placed between two cobblestone walls at the garden entrance) and face it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 allows detection from a natural viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the target. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the object'.

Uses inventory_has because mining is a task where the dropped item ends up in the player's inventory. Mature beetroots (age=3) drop 'beetroot' items (not 'beetroots' — the block name is 'beetroots' but the item drop is 'beetroot'). Checking for at least 1 beetroot in inventory is the most reliable signal that the player successfully broke a crop. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per the preference order.
